in_english.name: Sehr
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sehr originates from the Arabic root 's-h-r', meaning night, serenity, and peaceful evening. This term has spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing the tranquility and worship associated with the night. It is used across Muslim cultures to signify the beauty and reverence of the night.
